info.name: Event & Ticket System API
info.description:
Backend Assessment 1 - Node.js + Express + TypeScript + MySQL.

HOW TO USE THIS COLLECTION
1. Start the backend (`npm run dev`) - it auto-creates the database/tables and seeds demo data on first run.
2. Run requests top to bottom, folder by folder: Health -> Auth -> Events -> Bookings. Later requests depend on variables saved by earlier ones.
3. `token` and `adminToken` are filled in automatically by the Register/Login requests' "Tests" scripts - you never need to copy/paste a JWT by hand.
4. `eventId` and `bookingId` are filled in the same way by "Create Event" and "Book Ticket".

AUTH LEGEND (see each request name)
  [Public]     - no token needed
  [User]       - needs {{token}} (any logged in user)
  [Admin]      - needs {{adminToken}}

Demo accounts (created by `npm run seed`): admin@example.com / Admin@123, user@example.com / User@1234

variable.description: Backend base URL. Change the port here if PORT differs in .env.
JWT for a normal user. Auto-filled by Auth > Register (user) or Login (user).
JWT for an admin user. Auto-filled by Auth > Register (admin) or Login (admin).
Auto-filled by Events > Create Event (admin). Used by Get/Update/Delete Event and Book Ticket.
Auto-filled by Bookings > Book Ticket. Used by Cancel Booking.

request.description: Confirms the API is up. Expect 200 OK before running anything else.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Run one Register or Login request for a user AND one for an admin before touching the Events/Bookings folders - most of those requests need {{token}} or {{adminToken}} already set.

request.description:
Creates a normal (role: user) account and saves the returned JWT into {{token}}.

Expect 201 Created on first run. If this email is already registered (e.g. from the seed script), use "Login (user)" instead - expect 409 Conflict here.

Creates an admin account and saves the returned JWT into {{adminToken}}. Needed for the admin-only requests in the Events folder.

Expect 201 Created on first run, or 409 Conflict if this email already exists (use "Login (admin)" instead).
Logs in the normal demo user (already exists if you ran `npm run seed`) and saves the JWT into {{token}}. Expect 200 OK.
Logs in the admin demo user (already exists if you ran `npm run seed`) and saves the JWT into {{adminToken}}. Expect 200 OK.
Returns the profile of whoever owns {{token}}. Useful to confirm login worked and to check your role. Expect 200 OK, 401 if the token is missing/expired.

item.name: 2. Events
item.description: Browsing (List/Get) is public. Creating, updating and deleting an event all require {{adminToken}} - run Auth > Register/Login (admin) first.

request.description:
Admin only. Creates a new event and saves its id into {{eventId}} for the requests below.

`metadata` is free-form JSON - put whatever extra fields the event needs.
`total_tickets` cannot be changed later (see Update Event).

Expect 201 Created, 403 if {{adminToken}} belongs to a non-admin user.

query.description: Set to false to also see past events.
Optional: filter by title or location.

request.description: Public. Lists events with pagination. No token required. Expect 200 OK.
Public. Fetches one event using {{eventId}} (set by Create Event above, or paste any real id). Expect 200 OK, 404 if the id doesn't exist.
Admin only. Send only the fields you want to change. `total_tickets` is intentionally not editable here, to keep it consistent with `available_tickets`. Expect 200 OK.

Admin only. Soft-deletes the event (it is hidden, not physically removed). Run this last, after you're done testing Bookings against {{eventId}} - a booked event's tickets are still tied to it. Expect 200 OK, 409 if bookings still reference it.

item.name: 3. Bookings
item.description: Everything here needs {{token}} (any logged in user) - run Auth > Register/Login (user) first, and Events > Create Event so {{eventId}} is set.

request.description:
Books `quantity` tickets (1-10) for {{eventId}} and saves the new booking id into {{bookingId}}.

Expect 201 Created, 409 Conflict if fewer tickets remain than requested (safe to retry with a smaller quantity).
Lists every booking made by the logged-in user (the owner of {{token}}), including cancelled ones. Expect 200 OK.
Cancels {{bookingId}} (must belong to the logged-in user) and returns its tickets to the event. Expect 200 OK, 409 if it was already cancelled, 404 if it belongs to someone else.
